services.name: Heartland Horse Camp — Ride with at Venture Stables
services.desc: Welcome to Venture Stables Horse Day Camp, where every day is reminiscent of the heartwarming moments you'd find in Heartland. Immerse yourself in a world where horses become your companions, mentors, and friends, guiding you through an unforgettable equine adventure. Each day at Venture Stables begins with the promise of discovery and connection. As the sun rises over the rolling pastures, you'll embark on a journey to deepen your understanding of these majestic creatures. Through engaging and interactive sessions, you'll learn about horse care, grooming, and handling, gaining valuable Ages 5+ • 4 hours Everyday

services.name: Conscious Communication with Horses
services.desc: Incredible experience- We all learnt so much. My fear of horses was greatly reduced. Learning how to “speak horse” was wonderful. So glad we went! 1 Hour Available Times Mondays 10am 12pm 2pm May through November Important Information Age: 7 and up Weight Limit: 240lbs No pregnant riders, please About The horses will be waiting for us. Each horse has a different energy ""just like us"" you will get to choose a horse that you feel is speaking to you :) You will be taught the horsie handshake and begin your relationship with your chosen horse. You will halter your horse, lead and groom 1 hour • Ages 7+ • Designed for personal growth!

services.name: Adult Ride & Unwind Fridays
services.desc: Get out and have some fun with your friends! 1 hour 🌙 Ride & Unwind – Adult Fun Night at Venture Stables Looking for a fun, relaxing way to connect, move, and recharge? Join us for Adult Fun Night — a casual evening of riding, laughter, and mindfulness. 🐴 Perfect for beginners or those returning to the saddle, this program focuses on confidence, connection, and fun in a stress-free environment. Whether you’re riding for joy or exploring a new passion, this is your time to unwind and enjoy your horse time! 💛 🐎 Inclusions: Trail & arena riding Horse communication & mindfulness 1 hour • Ages 19+ • Every Friday Night!
